description.ja: 「境界戦機」より、I-LeS(自律思考型AI)を搭載したAMAIM(アメイン)「レイキ」が商品化！
description.en: From "Kyoukai Senki ", AMAIM " Reiki" equipped with I-LeS (autonomous thinking AI) is commercialized!

description.ja: ■KEN OKUYAMA DESIGNによる可動構造の検証を経て、立体化されたAMAIM(アメイン)。
description.en: • AMAIM was made into a three-dimensional model after the movable structure was verified by KEN OKUYAMA DESIGN.

description.ja: ■紫々部シオンがパイロットとして搭乗。
description.en: • Shion Murasakibe will be on board as the pilot.

description.ja: ■大型のリアスカートの展開に加え、全身に装備されたスラスターユニットは回転可能。
description.en: • In addition to deploying a large rear skirt, the thruster units equipped throughout the body can rotate.

description.ja: ■捕縛用電撃網発射機、超熱振式薙刀が付属。
description.en: • Comes with an electric net launcher for capture and a super heat wave naginata.

accessories.en: Super heat wave type naginata x 1
